title: IRONWEED frame size and voice overhead (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17): L_max 127 B on C4FM/4FSK narrowband, 1024 B on OFDM; TDMA slot length deferred as an open item; voice uses an implicit nonce derived from the 2-byte burst sequence counter (plus sender/key context so (key, nonce) never repeats) and a truncated voice authentication tag of 4-8 bytes (SRTP-style); first fix the §4.4 vs §7.3 frame layout contradiction (preamble and sync first; state whether the PHY header is inside the coded/encrypted block).
